faq.q: How do I install Archero on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for Archero and check the developer is Habby before tapping Install. It needs Android 7.0 or newer. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from Habby and may be altered, so the safest way to play Archero is the official listing.

faq.q: What are the best skills in Archero?
faq.a: Multishot, Front Arrow, Ricochet and Diagonal Arrows are strong early picks. Attack Boost and Attack Speed help every build.
Move to dodge; stand still to shoot automatically. Clear each room, pick a skill when you level up, and reach the boss at the end of the chapter.
Main chapters can be played offline, but events, rewards and some modes need a connection.
